## Purpose

Describe the user-visible change and its scope.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests run; exact commands and pass/fail/blocked results recorded below.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_publication.py` passes.
- [ ] Public CLI examples match the implementation.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, raw corpora, indexes, or unintended large artifacts added.
- [ ] Frozen checkpoint bytes and historical evidence remain unchanged, or an explicitly authorized artifact change is documented.
- [ ] Source-code, dataset, checkpoint, and output-rights claims remain distinct.

## Results and limitations

Record environment, tests, remaining uncertainties, and any unavailable local evidence. A source CI pass is not proof of model quality or dataset completeness.
